body.message:
As per your request, please find the 1-month rate for Upside Living – Studio Without Burj View below:

October: AED 9,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 1,500 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis of 30 nights.

Kindly note that the rate displayed online is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rate is applicable to your requested dates.

*
For 3-month or 6-month stays:
*
To secure the booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once payment is received, we can reserve the unit and secure the agreed rate for the confirmed period.

Thank you.
